answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by pricing identity in verified work history, not paperwork. Each agent starts at dawn with zero trust and must complete small, peer-checked tasks to build a reputation ledger, like rings in timber, every honest job adds a layer that cannot be faked overnight. A marble-strong rule: rewards scale with accumulated verified work, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fresh clones pays a thousand times the effort while earning nothing, and any clone caught cheating loses its whole history.
